title: Photo Metadata Inbox
user: Photographers with a large Lightroom-style library who need to progressively add captions and keywords without losing track of the untagged backlog.
smallest_useful_product: Local web app that imports filenames, folders, and existing IPTC/XMP; presents a finite untagged queue by event; applies templates and controlled vocabulary; writes sidecars plus a change log. Non-goals: AI auto-captioning, DAM hosting, or replacing an editor.
success_measure: At least 60% of pilot users clear 500 previously untagged assets in 30 days while exporting a portable XMP change log.
monetization: one-time — private local catalog work has clear episodic value and should not charge per image.
constraints: No image upload; never silently overwrite IPTC fields; configurable vocabulary; preserve original sidecars and write atomic backups.
why_distinct: The product is a completion-oriented metadata work queue, not another general photo library or generative caption service.
